title: API proposal : let the user pass a reference to a file for templating

comments.body: You mean we would then do something like an ajax call to load the template? Yes it works but is it a good practice to do X ajax calls to load templates?
Short answering no :). But it is both useful, and would let the user start nicely (using operated files for template) and right away.
I would rather go for inlined `$('<script type="text/template">....</script>').text()` I think. Introducing asynchronism here can be tricky.

> `$('<script type="text/template">....</script>').text()`

Then you do not need any of this, you just pass a string :)
@redox we can internalize the loading and asynchronousity.
Not sure of the benefits of that. Inline templating or `script` workaround seems easier to me, without adding complexity to our side.
This a public favorite, let's close this one!
